claims.quote: M. Bloch's thesis is that there is no war to come, that war indeed has already become impossible.
claims.description: Great-power war between industrialised nations will become impossible due to military, economic and political factors.

claims.quote: Thus, the great war cannot be made, and any attempt to make it would result in suicide.
claims.description: Any attempt at a great European war would end in catastrophe destroying existing political organisations.

claims.quote: Then, instead of a war fought out to the bitter end in a series of decisive battles, we shall have as a substitute a long period of continually increasing strain upon the resources of the combatants.
claims.description: Future war between great powers will become a prolonged stalemate of attrition between armies unable to deliver a decisive attack.

claims.quote: That is the future of war— not fighting, but famine, not the slaying of men, but the bankruptcy of nations and the break-up of the whole social organisation.
claims.description: Future war will cause famine, national bankruptcy and social collapse rather than decisive battle.

claims.quote: in future, war will be decided at ranges which will render the use of the bayonet impossible.
claims.description: Rifle fire at long range will make bayonet fighting obsolete and impossible in future battles.

claims.quote: They are, indeed, becoming so deadly that before long you will see they will never fight at all.
claims.description: Weapons will become so deadly that armies will cease to fight.

claims.quote: At first there will be increased slaughter — increased slaughter on so terrible a scale as to render it impossible to get troops to push the battle to a decisive issue.
claims.description: Initial battles with modern weapons will have such terrible slaughter that troops cannot be driven to decisive assault.

claims.quote: In the warfare of the future men will simply fall and die without either seeing or hearing anything.
claims.description: Smokeless powder and long-range rifles will cause soldiers to be killed by unseen, unheard enemies, greatly straining morale.

claims.quote: the rifle of to-morrow will be forty times as effective as the chassepot was in the Franco-Prussian war.
claims.description: Future rifles will be forty times as effective as 1870 rifles through faster fire, penetration and precision.

claims.quote: the 3 mm. gun will probably be the gun of the future, for the increased impetus of the small bore and its advantage in lightness will compel its adoption.
claims.description: Infantry rifles will shrink to 3 mm calibre, allowing soldiers to carry about 575 cartridges.

claims.quote: Now armies will no longer fight in the dark. Every soldier in the fighting line will see with frightful distinctness the havoc which is being made in the ranks
claims.description: Smokeless powder will remove the battlefield smoke screen, exposing soldiers to the visible horror of casualties.

claims.quote: the war of the future, the war which has become impossible, is the war that has haunted the imagination of mankind for the last thirty years
claims.description: A great war between the Triplice and the Franco-Russian Alliance has become impossible.
